proposed_objective.title: Enable autonomous repository research for KBX agents
proposed_objective.description: KBAgent can autonomously scan repository content (dependencies, structure, code patterns, docs) and persist findings as a knowledge graph to GraphDB for downstream query and visualization.
proposed_objective.success_criteria: One end-to-end flow: `kbx research` on a target repo produces a GraphDB-backed knowledge graph that can be served via `kbx serve`.

proposed_key_result.title: Auto-scan reference repo and persist to GraphDB
proposed_key_result.description: Validate the research pipeline by running `kbx research` on a known reference repo (e.g., a KBX agent repo) and confirming all findings are stored in GraphDB with cited evidence sources.
proposed_key_result.success_criteria: Pipeline runs without error, GraphDB contains nodes for dependencies, folder structure, code patterns, docs, and configuration. Each node includes confidence score and evidence source.

v2-8-kbagent-structured-store-spike.summary: The intent 'KBAgent structured store spike' explores a queryable state layer but has no linked key result. No existing KR matches; the closest (KR7.1) is about file architecture, not the spike itself.
v2-8-kbagent-structured-store-spike.why_now: This spike reduces ambiguity in KBAgent state querying. Without a key result, the work lacks traceability to measurable outcomes. Defining a new OKR now ensures alignment before execution starts.
v2-8-kbagent-structured-store-spike.next_action: Add a new objective and key result for this spike, then update the intent’s validation state and link. The spike should remain in backlog until its activation trigger (rule catalog hardening) is done.

proposed_objective.title: Enable queryable KBAgent state without breaking backward compatibility
proposed_objective.description: Create a minimal structured store layer that makes KBAgent state (rules, documents, intent status) queryable via simple queries, while keeping all existing Markdown/JSON file outputs unchanged.
proposed_objective.success_criteria: Spike produces an adapter and query model that passes at least 3 test queries (e.g., latest failed rules by intent, documents stale by verification window, active intents by release).

proposed_key_result.title: Structured store spike with backward compatibility verified
proposed_key_result.description: Design and implement a storage adapter and query model that mirrors current JSON/Markdown outputs, then validate with 3 representative queries.
proposed_key_result.success_criteria: All 3 test queries return correct results; existing file outputs remain unchanged
proposed_key_result.target: 3 queries passed with zero regression in file outputs

proposed_objective.title: Enable project-level customization of intent governance defaults
proposed_objective.description: Make KBX agent templates configurable per project so teams can override opinionated defaults (stale threshold, required fields, ID format, branch prefix, wave field, release reference format) without forking the template, while still receiving upgrade patches.
proposed_objective.success_criteria: Config layer is documented, implemented, and ships as part of V2.5 with at least one migration path for existing projects.

proposed_key_result.title: Config layer implemented for all six default categories
proposed_key_result.description: Deliver a config file (or equivalent) that allows overriding stale threshold, required fields, ID format, branch prefix, wave field, and release reference format. Must include an override log for auditability.
proposed_key_result.success_criteria: All six defaults overridable; config file schema published; upgrade path verified for at least one existing project.

proposed_objective.title: Enable operational visibility and data persistence for KBX agents
proposed_objective.description: Provide a production-grade database layer for KBX agent data and a web UI to manage intents, chaos scores, rule results, and audit events without requiring CLI commands for routine inspection.
proposed_objective.success_criteria: DB layer with SQLite adapter is feature-flagged and production-ready; Intent Web UI serves at least three core management views (list, detail, audit).

proposed_key_result.title: DB layer and Intent Web UI shipped as a single bundled release
proposed_key_result.description: SQLite adapter with migrations and seed logic, plus a local web server (`kbx serve`) providing intent management UI; governance UI reads from production DB.
proposed_key_result.success_criteria: Both components shipped together as release v2.9; `kbx init` creates empty .kb workspace; `kbx serve` runs without CLI-only inspection.
proposed_key_result.metric: Number of functional UI views shipped
